fields.submitted_link: The Amazon short link submitted by the user.
fields.intended_asin: The ASIN encoded in the submitted short link. Per Amazon, an ASIN is Amazon's checkable product identifier.
fields.official_listing_url: The official Amazon listing URL reached after resolving the short link. Left blank when no product destination could be confirmed.
fields.observed_redirect_target: The actual destination observed when the short link was fetched. Kept in a separate field from official_listing_url; the two are never merged.
fields.confirmation_date: Date the short link was fetched and resolved (local time, UTC per system date).
fields.status: verified when an official Amazon product page was reached; unverified otherwise.

note: Do not claim that supplied short links are invalid; their exact compliance status is unresolved. One link per product should be tested in the enrolled Associates workflow before scaling (test-link step not yet performed).
